userscripts.settings.heading: Userscripts
userscripts.settings.intro: Tampermonkey-style scripts that run automatically on matching pages in the built-in browser. They apply to every browser profile; switch each one on or off below. Save a .user.js source, or import one from an https URL.
userscripts.settings.agentNote: Scripts also run on pages the agent browses, so they can change what the agent reads. Only add scripts you trust. Network access (GM_xmlhttpRequest) and @require are deliberately not supported.
userscripts.settings.unavailable: Available in the installed app only — userscripts need the engine.
userscripts.settings.empty: No userscripts yet. Add one, or open a page in the browser and use ⋮ → Userscripts on this page → Create a script for this page.
userscripts.settings.deleteDesc: The script and its source are removed for good.
userscripts.editor.hint: Edit the full source including the ==UserScript== header — @name is required. Supported: @match, @include, @exclude, @run-at, @noframes, and grants none, GM_addStyle, GM_info, unsafeWindow.
userscripts.toast.savedWarnings: Script saved with {count} warning(s) — see the list in Settings → Userscripts.
userscripts.menu.title: Userscripts on this page
userscripts.menu.create: Create a script for this page…
